name: NGC 4889 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4889, a giant elliptical galaxy in the Coma Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4889-hubble
story: A giant elliptical at the heart of the Coma Cluster, home to a record-breaking supermassive black hole some 21 billion times the mass of the Sun. Today that black hole lies dormant, napping between meals.

claims.text: NGC 4889 is a giant elliptical galaxy in the Coma Cluster
It hosts a record-breaking supermassive black hole of about 21 billion solar masses
NGC 4889 is one of the two giant galaxies defining the core of the Coma cluster
